accepted_review_findings:
[reviewer finding R2, low] A scripted check auto-fails figures below 600 px in either dimension, but the solver never sees that requirement. task.md makes figure size a solver choice and only recommends 150 dpi. A plausible design, such as a 1x3 small-multiples figure at 12 x 3.5 in and 150 dpi (1800 x 525 px), follows every public instruction and still fails the hidden check.
Required repair: Add one identical public sentence to task.md Deliverables item 2 and to output_contract.deliverables[1].description: 'The PNG must be at least 600 px in both width and height.' Alternatively, remove the pixel threshold from verification_plan.deterministic_checks[3] and rubric A.4. Keep the 'figure size' solver choice above the minimum. Update the hashes of changed assets.

[reviewer finding R3, low] The public caption requirements say nothing about disclosing spread truncation at zero or explaining an omitted spread. Public text requires that explanation only in manifest.spread_encoding. The private rubric penalises a caption that leaves it out, so a solver who follows the public instructions can be marked down by a criterion it could not see.
Required repair: Choose one. (a) Add a bullet to task.md item 3 and the caption deliverable description: 'how the spread is drawn, including any handling below zero, or that it is available but not drawn'. (b) Change rubric B.3 to require this disclosure only in spread_encoding. Do not change the spread label or data.
